LESSON: WILDLIFE AND TOURISM IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Resources and Economic Activities in Eastern Africa
Topic 3.3: Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can we promote tourism in our country?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain factors that promote tourism in Eastern Africa
2. explain challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa
3. state possible solutions to challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa
4. value tourism as an economic activity

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: WILDLIFE AND TOURISM IN EASTERN AFRICA
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa helps you succeed in SOCIAL STUDIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

KEY FACTS: WILDLIFE AND TOURISM IN EASTERN AFRICA
Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.
Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.
Rights come with responsibilities.

PART 1: Explain factors that promote tourism in Eastern Africa

What this means
In this part you learn to explain factors that promote tourism in Eastern Africa. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain factors that promote tourism in Eastern Africa.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Locate: Connect “Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home).

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain factors that promote tourism in Eastern Africa. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Explain challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa

What this means
In this part you learn to explain challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Give one cause and one effect linked to Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: State possible solutions to challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa

What this means
In this part you learn to state possible solutions to challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: state possible solutions to challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Participate: Describe one responsible action a Grade learner can take.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can state possible solutions to challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Value tourism as an economic activity

What this means
In this part you learn to value tourism as an economic activity. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: value tourism as an economic activity.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Locate: Connect “Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home).

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can value tourism as an economic activity. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

KEY FACTS: WILDLIFE AND TOURISM IN EASTERN AFRICA

Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.

Example 1: Connect “Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home). (skill: explain factors that promote tourism in Eastern Africa)

Example 2: Give one cause and one effect linked to Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa. (skill: explain challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa)

Example 3: Describe one responsible action a Grade learner can take. (skill: state possible solutions to challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa)

Example 4: Connect “Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home). (skill: value tourism as an economic activity)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain factors that promote tourism in Eastern Africa.
3. Practise this skill: explain challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa.
4. Practise this skill: state possible solutions to challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we promote tourism in our country?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain factors that promote tourism in Eastern Africa.
5. Be able to: explain challenges facing tourism in Eastern Africa.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
